notes.title: Demo Update v0.2.5
notes.notes:
Keep your eyes PEELED (that sounds painful) over the next couple of weeks for exciting news coming out of Grumpy Pizza HQ - a.k.a. my spare bedroom - regarding Go Kart Island... but in the mean time you'll have to settle for a new demo update.

Look at all this stuff. LOOK AT IT!

NEW FEATURES

Kart steering amounts are increased when driving at slow speeds

Start boost is applied by holding only acceleration, rather than both brake and acceleration

Added support for native Steam Deck resolution 1280x800, and also 1920x1200 'cause YOLO

Various SFX balances and updates

Race checkpoints (white and purple smoke columns) are no longer present

Various optimisations

UI and SFX changes to highlight when only one heart remains in Death Races

Shadows now appear directly underneath Squish-E-Boi obstacles

Info messages (that appear at the bottom of the screen) are displayed on screen for longer

Farm Race: Disabled the silver coin next to the starting grid until the 1st lap and added extra tyre walls

Improved directing the player in the tutorial mission

Added a message to direct player to find the paint shop after finding first collectable kart

Added a prompt after completing the demo to play Challenges

Improved "locked" and "trophy" icons


BUG FIXES

Fixed the main menu getting into a state where no buttons could be selected with a controller

Fixed the kart selection button from being pressed multiple times, which caused the selected Challenge to load multiple times

Fixed invincibility being stuck on permanently (for real this time, I think)

Fixed AI racers not apply correct start boost values

Fixed new laps not triggering on the Farm Race

Fixed the respawning positions on the "Chicken Run" collect event

Fixed being able to outrun the Squish-E-Boi item without using a speed boost

Fixed slowdown penalty being applied when hit by a laser while the shield was active

Fixed oil and egg appearing to float slightly above ground

Fixed the collision of donut obstacles so you can't pass under them

Fixed yacht in Main Town not having any collision

Fixed benches props not resetting position

Fixed duplicated SFX playing on the character selection screen

notes.title: Demo Update v0.2.3
notes.notes:
Hello! 

I've been hard at work getting the full game ready for playtesting, and in the process there's been a load of changes that affect the demo, so I guess it's update time! 

Why not get this downloaded onto your computer box and give them a go? DO IT!


NEW FEATURES

Made some tweaks to the kart handling to make it feel less "floaty"

Added a controls screen that can be accessed from the pause menu

Added a "hole" to the moving mayor board obstacle, so their location is always visible

Added SFX when passing through race checkpoints

Added SFX for the train

Balancing pass of various existing sound effects

Various UI tweaks and improvements

Fuel pump props can be hit and explode 

Tweaked shadow appearances on various surfaces

The chicken feeder prop is no longer static, will be moved by the player when hit

Moved the position of some collectable items

Sand slows down karts slightly more

Renamed the "Exit to Desktop" button to "Exit Game" when playing on Steam Deck

Added splash screen


BUG FIXES

Fixed instance where the driftsliding state would not stop when expected

Fixed behind camera being stuck "on" after being hit or after an event ended

Fixed various textures that were not displaying as intended

Fixed the Lachlan minimap icon alignment

Fixed music being audible when the loading screen appeared, while music volume was set to 0

Fixed racers in the "Follow the Husband!" event stopping when the player kart was in front of them

Fixed a duplicated fence near the marina

Fixed NPCs that were misaligned with their karts 

Fixed Shelly not facing the player kart when being dropped off at home in the tutorial event

notes.title: Demo Update v0.2.2
notes.notes:
Hello!

A couple of updates have been pushed over the last week - mostly minor updates and balancing tweaks. Have a look here, I made a handy list. Don't say I don't treat you.

v0.2.2

Improved kart landings after using a jump pad so speed is not reduced

Balanced "Wedding Dash" and "Mrs Ham's Private Bus" time trials

Balanced "Chicken Run" collect event time limits

Pole added to laser obstacles

Changed default camera damping to lowest setting

Changed default SFX volume to 8

Prevented the item tutorial appearing on a new save game

Various UI improvements

Fixed kart momentum not stopping when respawning

Fixed the minimap not rotating 45 degrees using the perspective camera



v0.2.1

New NPC characters: Giraffe, Zebra, Bat and Flamingo

Improved collision on the donut obstacles

Improved collision on fences

Updated best time/score star icon in Challenges

notes.title: Demo Update v0.2.0
notes.notes:
The second number went up this time instead of the third number so you know this is a BANGER update.


NEW FEATURES

Added three different difficulties - Rookie (Easy), Pro (Normal) and Champion (Hard)

Added three save slots for Story Mode

Added the paint shop, allowing you to change kart colour in Story Mode

Increased the amount of laps in the Town, Forest and Farm races from 3 to 5

Updated character models for Hank, Cali and Rich Penelope

New music added when exploring the game world in Story Mode

Various new UI visuals implemented

The intro tutorial event can now be skipped if it has been completed once

The game now pauses when the gamepad is disconnected

Added an option to modify the amount of horizontal camera yaw/damping applied when turning


BUG FIXES

Fixed laser item slowing you down when you were invincible or big

Fixed laser slowdown not being applied after a boost ended

Fixed the "use item" tutorial message not being removed in some circumstances

Fixed being able to go under speed boosters when in the squished state

Fixed barrier items not moving after being hit

Fixed SFX balancing for "size increase" and "laser" items

Fixed collectables panel appearing on the pause menu during Challenges

Fixed Squish-E-Boi item appearing after a race concludes

Fixed various prop placement bugs

notes.title: Demo Update v0.1.6
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:

Some minor AI balancing

Improved AI navigation on the forest checkpoint race

Fixed a bug where numbers would not appear occasionally during the start countdown

Fixed a bug where the main menu would flicker when loading after playing a Challenge

notes.title: Demo Update v0.1.5
notes.notes:
Another small update!

Correct button prompts are now displayed on Steam Deck

Added an option to reduce the amount of camera damping when turning corners

Updated the settings menu

Improved shadow appearance

Added a new icon for the "BIG" item

Improved signposting and added a new position reset on the tutorial mission

Fixed being able to access video options when playing on Steam Deck

Fixed gameplay SFX not playing in certain circumstances when loading the tutorial mission

notes.title: Demo Update v0.1.4
notes.notes:
Hello! I have fixed some issues and implemented a couple of features that were raised over the weekend. That's all. THANKS BYE.



Added a button to skip dialogue and start an event immediately

Moved colliders on jumping donut and mayor board obstacles so they aren't clipped as easily when underground

NPCs rotate to face Lachlan when talking

Allow players to close the "success" screen when the money count up animation is playing

Updated the UI used for the "distance bar" on the Pursuit event

Moved some trees in the forest area and added extra tyre barriers during the checkpoint race

Added the total amount of available collectables to the pause menu display

Fixed not being able to open the pause menu in some circumstances

Fixed skidding SFX not stopping when triggering a dialogue

Fixed green artefacts being visible on the minimap in lower resolutions

Fixed the laser item hitting time checkpoints

Fixed item tutorial text not scaling correctly on lower resolutions

Fixed shadows not appearing on some surfaces

Fixed dialogue sometimes disappearing early when entering the town in the tutorial event
